name: Line chart board
summary: Presentation board on a tripod easel with a rising line chart, dots and an arrow; anim draw traces the line.

params.name: y
params.note: floor point under the easel centre (1 m ~ 560 px)

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the easel is about 500 px wide and 900 px tall

params.name: anim
params.note: draw = the line is traced from left to right; frame 0 shows the first quarter

author: krakujs
